user.title: Connect to Vibbo
user.description:
Home Assistant uses your browser's Vibbo session to read the feed.

1. Log in at [vibbo.no](https://vibbo.no) in a desktop browser.
2. Open the developer tools (F12) and go to the **Network** tab, then reload the page.
3. Right-click any request to `vibbo.no` and choose **Copy → Copy as cURL**.
4. Paste it below. Only the `sesid` and `sesid.sig` cookies are kept.

You can also paste just the request's `Cookie` header, or the two cookies from **Application → Cookies** (Chrome) / **Storage → Cookies** (Firefox) written as `sesid=…; sesid.sig=…`.

data_description.cookie: A cURL command, a Cookie header, or `sesid=…; sesid.sig=…`. The session lasts about a year.
